Frequently.title: How much does it cost to develop a logistics app?
Frequently.desc: Logistics app development costs range from $8,000 for a basic courier app to $150,000+ for an enterprise-grade TMS with full ERP integration. The main cost drivers are the number of user panels (customer, driver, dispatcher, admin), the complexity of real-time tracking features, third-party API integrations, and whether you need iOS, Android, or both. Contact us for a free, detailed estimate based on your specific requirements.

Frequently.title: How long does it take to build a logistics app?
Frequently.desc: A basic on-demand delivery app typically takes 6–12 weeks. A full-featured logistics platform with fleet management, ERP integration, and multi-panel dashboards takes 16–24 weeks. We work in agile 2-week sprints so you see working software throughout the process, not just at the end.

Frequently.title: Can you integrate a logistics app with our existing ERP system?
Frequently.desc: Yes. We regularly build logistics apps that integrate with SAP, Oracle, Tally, Zoho, and custom legacy ERPs via REST APIs, webhooks, or custom middleware. We map your existing data flows and build the integration layer without requiring you to replace your current ERP.

Frequently.title: Do you build iOS and Android logistics apps?
Frequently.desc: We build cross-platform logistics apps using React Native and Flutter, which means you get both iOS and Android apps from a single codebase — reducing cost and keeping both apps in sync. For enterprise clients with specific performance requirements, we also offer native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) development.

Frequently.title: What is the difference between a TMS and a WMS?
Frequently.desc: A Transport Management System (TMS) manages the movement of goods — including carrier selection, route planning, freight booking, and shipment tracking. A Warehouse Management System (WMS) focuses on warehouse operations such as inventory management, picking, packing, and dispatch. Many businesses require both systems integrated into a single logistics platform.

Frequently.title: Do you provide post-launch support for logistics apps?
Frequently.desc: Yes. We offer 3, 6, and 12-month post-launch support packages that include bug fixes, OS updates, performance monitoring, and feature enhancements. Our team ensures your logistics app stays secure, updated, and optimized for long-term success.

Frequently.title: Can you build a white-label logistics app?
Frequently.desc: Yes. We develop fully customizable white-label logistics platforms for aggregators, franchises, and SaaS businesses. You get a ready-to-launch, branded solution that can be deployed for multiple clients under your own brand.
